descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper name (חֶבְרוֹן II) referring to a person, not the well-known city, specifically a son of Kohath and grandson of Levi who appears in Levitical genealogies (Exod 6:18; Num 3:19; 1 Chr 6:2,18; 15:9; 23:12,19). Multilingual renderings are consistent: eng 'Hebron/Chevron', spa 'Hebrón/Jebron', hin 'हेब्रोन', arb 'حَبْرُون', kor '헤브론', swa 'Hebroni'. The prepositional form (בְּחֶבְרוֹן 'in Hebron') with locative sense represents a grammatical variant of the same proper noun used in context.
